Musopen Symphony (orchestra, as named on Commons) Disputed: sources disagree

Commons names Musopen Symphony; the upstream FLAC entry names Czech National Symphony Orchestra. A relationship between project credit and ensemble name is possible but not documented. No conductor is supplied.

[1]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — explicit PD-author public-domain dedication of the recording by Musopen Documented

Commons explicitly applies the Musopen release to the sound recording. The Public Domain Mark is descriptive; it is not treated as an independent licence or as proof derived from the composition’s age.

[1]

Musopen Symphony (Commons credit); Czech National Symphony Orchestra (upstream credit; attribution unresolved). Musopen Kickstarter Project, via Internet Archive and Wikimedia Commons. Public-domain dedication attributed to Musopen. Rights statement
